question: Which attendant deities and weapons accompany Śiva in the surrounding worship?
premises: Śiva is worshipped together with attendant powers.
The lords of gaṇas and world guardians are included.
Weapons beginning with the vajra are included.
inference: The worship includes the lords of gaṇas, the world guardians, and weapons beginning with the vajra.
plain_english: together with the lords of the gaṇas and the world guardians, and with weapons beginning with the vajra,
